title: Saudi SABIC narrows Q2 loss to $221mln on higher selling prices, but revenue dips
summary: The company also announced dividends of SAR 3.3 billion for H1
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
FILE PHOTO: The headquarters of Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) is seen in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia April 19, 2016. REUTERS/Faisal Al Nasser. Image used for illustrative purpose.

The company also announced dividends of SAR 3.3 billion for H1

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) narrowed Q2 2026 net loss to SAR830 million ($221.3 million), from a net loss of SAR4billion in the year-earlier period.
